model_gate.evaluation: all eligible candidates; positive-containing Recall@5/10/20 and MRR plus all-provider-year precision and recommendation burden
model_gate.high_score_threshold: fixed 95th percentile of strictly prior candidate scores; operational flag, not calibrated confidence
model_gate.negative_sampling: training only; no sampled evaluation negatives

limitations: Part D labels are published observations subject to suppression and left censoring; CMS suppresses provider-drug combinations with 10 or fewer Part D claims.
The target is not a first prescription, prescribing start, or verified molecule identity.
Generic-only is the primary source-text representation; exact brand+generic is a sensitivity representation.
No RxNorm or molecule-level clinical-equivalence mapping is asserted.
The bounded model gate does not establish full national scalability or benchmark admission.
Historical publication-time availability is not verified, so this is not deployment-valid next-calendar-year forecasting.
ClinicalTrials requires historical pre-outcome predictors and is not a legal-compliance target.
FAERS observations are not causal drug-safety labels and may duplicate MAUDE's relational regime.
